morning.caption:
US stock futures rose on Sunday night after Wall Street's worst week since 2020. Dow futures gained 798 points after the S&P 500 fell 8.6% last week. Taiwan had its worst week since 1991 and Korea's KOSPI fell 3.3% on Monday. Gold rose to $3,607.55.

Watch Wednesday's PCE inflation report. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com

midday.caption:
CrowdStrike agreed on Monday to buy Zscaler in an all-stock deal valued at about $43.9 billion. Zscaler holders get 1.135 CrowdStrike shares each, about $260.41, a 34% premium. Founder Jay Chaudhry will join CrowdStrike's board. The deal needs shareholder and regulatory approval. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com

evening.caption:
Iran's Revolutionary Guard said it struck US positions in Bahrain, which reported a fire at a civilian site. The Houthis claimed an attack on a Saudi refinery, with no damage confirmed. UKMTO counted 263 ships through Hormuz in a week, down 15%. Brent was $92.10 on Monday. Watch OPEC+ on November 29. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com
